scope: Real pinned Pocket worker, two explicitly synthetic reviewed segments, isolated output and configuration; read-only reuse of installed assets/interpreter, not clean setup, native cache or human listening acceptance.
segments: The font's bytes first reach a format probe. The loader chooses a parser before an outline can be built.
After hinting adjusts the outline, rasterization turns its edges into pixel coverage. A bitmap is returned only when rendering succeeds.
networkIsolation: Explicit offline environment and local model config; no network syscall tracing.
